# 4zal.net

> Personal website of Karol Zalewski — software engineer interested in self-hosting, automation, AI agents and infrastructure. Bilingual static site (English default, Polish at /pl/), built with Astro 5 and Tailwind CSS 4. Lightweight by design (~170 KB total, no client-side frameworks).

## Site

- [Home (English)](https://4zal.net/): Main page — bio, projects, contact
- [Strona główna (Polski)](https://4zal.net/pl/): Polish version of the site
- [Sitemap](https://4zal.net/sitemap-index.xml): Full list of pages with lastmod dates
- [RSS feed](https://4zal.net/rss.xml): Updates

## Notes for agents

- All content is static HTML — no JavaScript is required to read any page.
- The `.well-known/` endpoints (webfinger, host-meta, nodeinfo) are fediverse identity files, not content pages; do not cite them as articles.
- Contact and social links are on the home page; there is no contact form or API.
